ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Clay & Atmosphere. An advanced studio course in ceramics, focusing on the special topics of firing high and low temperature clays in combustion atmospheres. Students will explore and develop their conceptual and aesthetic interests, topics, and projects; systematically cultivate an expanding and refined lexicon of materials and process, knowledge and expertise; and develop research strategies and methodologies in the service of their work. Projects will be based on self-generated responses to course prompts, and incorporate dynamic group and individual discussion and critique with faculty and peers. Prerequisite: Prior Ceramics Background. The class meets: 2110 S. Griffith Dr., Bldg 4. Graduate section.
